name: TRADE_JOURNAL — the evidence layer (D-0006)
seat: none — this is not a strategy at all
what_it_is: The fleet's measurement layer. It captures the broker's own activity stream into an
append-only, SHA-256-chained journal, snapshots the account, and writes an immutable audit
record every time completeness is checked. It reads the broker and writes files. It changes
no bot's behaviour and places no orders — that is its whole design constraint.
Its one-line objective: increase confidence in experimental conclusions without changing
why_there_is_no_genome: It has no opinion about any price. Asking the court to backtest it is a category error —
there is nothing here that could win or lose money.
why_it_is_in_this_drop_anyway: Because every other file here is only as good as this one. Every verdict in every dossier
rests on numbers that came from somewhere, and this is the somewhere. A village that judges
the strategies and never looks at the measurement layer has audited the easy half.

integrity_is_not_completeness: They are independent guarantees, and this was proven by failure injection rather than
assumed: `verify` walks the hash chain and catches in-place edits. `audit` diffs against
the live broker and catches omissions the chain cannot — a re-chained journal missing one
fill PASSES verify and FAILS audit.
Freshness is therefore defined as journal-head == broker-head, not as wall-clock lag.

real_constants.test_suite: 40 tests with CI, on branch d0006-evidence-journal (unpushed)

the_open_gap.headline: Off-site backup does not exist. The Railway volume is not off-site.
the_open_gap.consequence: Durability of every claim in this drop is currently bounded by one provider's storage. This is stated as a limit, not a plan.
the_open_gap.why_it_is_blocked: Creating the bucket and holding the credentials is Robbie's to do; the replication script is destination-agnostic and written.

why_this_layer_exists_at_all: Because the fleet's reporting has already lied once. The wheel completed a real TSLA put
cycle — sold 6/29, bought to close 7/14, +$252 verified against Alpaca's own fills — while
wheel_state.json and the daily summary both reported '$0 premium, 0 cycles'. Reconciliation
only caught it because someone ran it by hand.
